The United Kingdom generated the highest total revenue of 17,057.19, accounting for approximately 77.2% of total revenue (22,106.60). This indicates that the business relies heavily on the UK market.
The United Kingdom recorded 893 transactions, compared with 20 in Germany and 19 each in France and Ireland. This shows that sales activity is strongly concentrated in the UK.

Denmark recorded the highest average revenue per transaction at 541.80, followed by the Netherlands at 174.43. Although these countries generated less total revenue than the UK, their higher averages suggest that their transactions were more valuable on average.

Germany recorded 20 transactions with an average revenue of 23.95, while Ireland recorded 19 transactions with a higher average of 53.16. This suggests that countries with similar transaction counts can generate different amounts of revenue per transaction.

Assorted Farmyard Animals In Bucket generated the highest product revenue at 993.60, followed by Gold Wine Glass at 976.32. The business could investigate opportunities to promote these strong-performing products while reviewing products with negative revenue values to understand possible returns or refunds.
